hero.title: Good shoes deserve *a second life*
hero.lede: Shoe, boot and leather repair at 130 Park Avenue SE, from a downtown shop that has been in business for more than seventy years.

130 Park Avenue SE in downtown Aiken.

before: No website of its own: a search leads to directory listings and a Facebook page
One listing still gives an old Richland Avenue address
The first thing a new customer sees is not something the shop controls
after: A site the shop owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room to add before-and-after photos of repairs as the shop supplies them
